notes: Zendesk for Slack ticket notifications. Card = section with linked ticket title (#id + subject) + fields (Status/Priority/Requester/Assignee) + optional latest-comment quote + context footer (org, channel, SLA) + 'View ticket' URL button. Fits support, escalation, and dev channels where customer-reported bugs land.
